svg.title: Fencing: a change is numbered when its transaction commits, so a pull's cursor never passes a change it has not seen.
svg.desc: Numbered at commit, never skipped. Transaction A and Transaction B write to a synced table while a pull reads the changelog and keeps a cursor, and the consistency horizon under the changelog marks the highest position the pull may resume from. First the numbers are drawn at write time: A draws 100 and stays open, B draws 101 and commits, and the pull sees 101 and moves its cursor to 101. When A finally commits, 100 lands behind the cursor, and the next request asks only for numbers above 101, so the late arrival is skipped. Then the numbers are drawn at commit, the rule kizunasync follows: A has no number while it stays open, B commits as 101 and the cursor moves to 101, A commits and draws 102 above the cursor, and the next pull delivers 102 as the horizon advances.
svg.text: A change gets its sequence number when its transaction commits, so a pull's cursor never passes a row it has not seen.
